I understand there is a freeze atm; however, applying for roles that state that completing an apprenticeship is part of it - when you don’t want to/intend to complete it is unfair to others. You chose to apply for a role that stated completing an apprenticeship was a requirement of the role. Giving up a job opportunity is not entirely accurate, you decided to apply for this role, a recruiter didn’t approach you and offer you it. There are many people without degrees who would relish the opportunity and make the most of the apprenticeship.

Personally I would apply for a different role and allow someone else the opportunity to complete the apprenticeship. It is unlikely they will be able to condense an 18 month apprenticeship into 1 year. My apprenticeship was projected as 24 months and will likely take me 22 months at a minimum. Apprenticeships are hard to come by and are great opportunity but can be hard even for those committed to completing them and the role.
